question: In the 18th and 19th centuries, what were the 'Highland Clearances'?
options: The removal of people from their land in Scotland to make way for sheep and cattle
The demolition of castles after the Jacobite rebellion
The clearing of forests to build warships
The draining of marshland in eastern England
explanation: Scottish landlords cleared people from their land to make room for large flocks of sheep and cattle, in what became known as the Highland Clearances. Many people were forced to move to towns or emigrate.
